words.definitionEn: relating to serious study at school or university; collocations: academic writing, academic performance, academic year
words.exampleEn: Your essay should be written in a formal academic style.
words.exampleUz: Inshoyingiz rasmiy akademik uslubda yozilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to officially join a course or school; collocation: enrol on/in a course (enrol (v) — enrolment (n))
words.exampleEn: Over two thousand students enrolled on the online course.
words.exampleUz: Ikki mingdan ortiq talaba onlayn kursga ro'yxatdan o'tdi.

words.definitionEn: teaching, especially in small groups; key collocation: tuition fees
words.exampleEn: Tuition fees at private universities have risen sharply.
words.exampleUz: Xususiy universitetlarda o'qish haqi keskin oshdi.

words.definitionEn: a university student who has not yet taken a first degree; collocation: undergraduate student/course
words.exampleEn: She is an undergraduate in the faculty of economics.
words.exampleUz: U iqtisodiyot fakultetining bakalavr talabasi.

words.definitionEn: a student who continues studying after a first degree; collocation: postgraduate studies
words.exampleEn: He applied for a postgraduate programme in Germany.
words.exampleUz: U Germaniyadagi magistratura dasturiga ariza topshirdi.

words.definitionEn: a teacher at a university; collocation: a senior lecturer (lecture (n/v) — lecturer (n))
words.exampleEn: The lecturer explained the topic with clear examples.
words.exampleUz: Ma'ruzachi mavzuni aniq misollar bilan tushuntirdi.

words.definitionEn: a class where a small group discusses a topic; collocation: attend/hold a seminar
words.exampleEn: We discussed the article in yesterday's seminar.
words.exampleUz: Kechagi seminarda maqolani muhokama qildik.

words.definitionEn: a short lesson for one or a few students, or a guide that teaches a skill step by step
words.exampleEn: The video tutorial explains how to write an opinion essay.
words.exampleUz: Video qo'llanma fikr inshosini qanday yozishni tushuntiradi.

words.definitionEn: a piece of work given to a student; collocation: complete/submit an assignment
words.exampleEn: You must submit the written assignment before Friday.
words.exampleUz: Yozma topshiriqni juma kunigacha topshirishingiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: the latest time by which something must be finished; collocations: meet a deadline, miss a deadline
words.exampleEn: Very few students met the deadline for the project.
words.exampleUz: Loyiha muddatiga juda kam talaba ulgurdi.

words.definitionEn: work students do during a course that counts towards the final mark
words.exampleEn: Half of the final mark comes from coursework.
words.exampleUz: Yakuniy bahoning yarmi kurs ishlaridan keladi.

words.definitionEn: a long piece of writing on one subject, usually for a degree; collocation: write/defend a dissertation
words.exampleEn: She is writing her dissertation on bilingual education.
words.exampleUz: U ikki tilli ta'lim bo'yicha bitiruv ishini yozmoqda.

words.definitionEn: the main idea an essay tries to prove, or a long research paper; collocation: thesis statement (thesis (sing.) — theses (pl.))
words.exampleEn: A strong essay begins with a clear thesis statement.
words.exampleUz: Kuchli insho aniq tezis jumlasi bilan boshlanadi.

words.definitionEn: using someone else's words or ideas as your own; collocation: commit plagiarism (plagiarise (v) — plagiarism (n))
words.exampleEn: Copying sentences from the internet counts as plagiarism.
words.exampleUz: Internetdan jumlalarni ko'chirish plagiat hisoblanadi.

words.definitionEn: the standards used to judge something; collocation: meet the criteria (criterion (sing.) — criteria (pl.))
words.exampleEn: Your essay is marked against four assessment criteria.
words.exampleUz: Inshoyingiz to'rtta baholash mezoni bo'yicha tekshiriladi.

words.definitionEn: to judge how good or useful something is; collocation: evaluate the results/evidence (evaluate (v) — evaluation (n))
words.exampleEn: The report evaluates the impact of the new teaching method.
words.exampleUz: Hisobot yangi o'qitish usulining ta'sirini baholaydi.

words.definitionEn: an exam result or degree that shows your level; collocation: gain/hold a qualification (qualify (v) — qualification (n), qualified (adj))
words.exampleEn: A teaching qualification is required for this position.
words.exampleUz: Bu lavozim uchun pedagogik malaka talab qilinadi.

words.definitionEn: the ability to read and write; collocations: literacy rate, digital literacy (literate (adj) — literacy (n))
words.exampleEn: Uzbekistan has a very high literacy rate.
words.exampleUz: O'zbekistonda savodxonlik darajasi juda yuqori.

words.definitionEn: teaching the practical skills needed for a particular job; collocation: vocational training/college
words.exampleEn: Vocational training helps young people find work quickly.
words.exampleUz: Kasb-hunar ta'limi yoshlarga tez ish topishga yordam beradi.

words.definitionEn: to finish your studies and receive a degree; collocation: graduate from university (graduate (v/n) — graduation (n))
words.exampleEn: He graduated from the university with honours.
words.exampleUz: U universitetni imtiyozli diplom bilan bitirdi.

words.definitionEn: a person who guides your research or checks your work; collocation: research supervisor (supervise (v) — supervisor (n))
words.exampleEn: My supervisor gave detailed comments on chapter two.
words.exampleUz: Ilmiy rahbarim ikkinchi bobga batafsil izohlar berdi.

words.definitionEn: a person of the same age or position as you; collocations: peer pressure, peer review
words.exampleEn: Peer feedback helps students notice their own mistakes.
words.exampleUz: Tengdoshlar fikri talabalarga o'z xatolarini payqashga yordam beradi.

words.definitionEn: advice about how well you are doing; collocation: give/receive constructive feedback
words.exampleEn: The teacher gave useful feedback on my speaking.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchi nutqim bo'yicha foydali fikr-mulohaza bildirdi.

words.definitionEn: a list of the topics to be studied in a course; collocation: cover the syllabus
words.exampleEn: The syllabus lists all the topics for the term.
words.exampleUz: Sillabusda semestrdagi barcha mavzular ko'rsatilgan.

words.definitionEn: the reason and desire to do something; collocation: lose/keep motivation (motivate (v) — motivation (n), motivated (adj))
words.exampleEn: Clear goals increase students' motivation to study.
words.exampleUz: Aniq maqsadlar talabalarning o'qishga motivatsiyasini oshiradi.

words.definitionEn: controlled behaviour, or a branch of knowledge; collocations: strict discipline, an academic discipline
words.exampleEn: Self-discipline matters more than talent in exam preparation.
words.exampleUz: Imtihonga tayyorgarlikda o'z-o'zini intizomga solish iste'doddan muhimroq.

words.definitionEn: a strong wish to learn or know something; collocation: arouse curiosity (curious (adj) — curiosity (n))
words.exampleEn: Curiosity is what turns a student into a researcher.
words.exampleUz: Qiziquvchanlik talabani tadqiqotchiga aylantiradi.

words.definitionEn: the ability to understand what you read or hear; collocations: reading comprehension, listening comprehension
words.exampleEn: The test measures reading comprehension, not memory.
words.exampleUz: Test xotirani emas, matnni tushunishni o'lchaydi.

words.definitionEn: a high level of skill in something; collocations: language proficiency, a proficiency test (proficient (adj) — proficiency (n))
words.exampleEn: The certificate shows your level of language proficiency.
words.exampleUz: Sertifikat til malakangiz darajasini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: the ability to speak or write smoothly without long pauses; collocation: develop fluency (fluent (adj) — fluency (n))
words.exampleEn: Speaking practice develops fluency faster than grammar drills.
words.exampleUz: Gapirish mashqi ravonlikni grammatik mashqlardan tezroq rivojlantiradi.

words.definitionEn: able to speak two languages well; collocation: bilingual education
words.exampleEn: Many children in Tashkent grow up bilingual.
words.exampleUz: Toshkentdagi ko'p bolalar ikki tilli bo'lib ulg'ayadi.

words.definitionEn: to learn something so that you remember it exactly; collocation: memorise vocabulary (memorise (v) — memory (n))
words.exampleEn: Do not simply memorise phrases; learn how to use them.
words.exampleUz: Iboralarni shunchaki yodlamang; ularni qanday ishlatishni o'rganing.

words.definitionEn: to describe the main ideas without giving details; collocation: outline a plan/an argument
words.exampleEn: The introduction outlines the main arguments of the essay.
words.exampleUz: Kirish qismi inshoning asosiy dalillarini qisqacha bayon qiladi.

words.definitionEn: an early version of a piece of writing; collocation: a first draft, a final draft
words.exampleEn: Always check your first draft for spelling mistakes.
words.exampleUz: Qoralamangizni doim imlo xatolari uchun tekshiring.

words.definitionEn: a mention of a source you used in your work; collocation: a list of references (refer (v) — reference (n))
words.exampleEn: Add a full list of references at the end of the report.
words.exampleUz: Hisobot oxirida to'liq manbalar ro'yxatini qo'shing.

words.definitionEn: a small group or amount used to represent the whole; collocation: a random sample of
words.exampleEn: The study used a sample of five hundred school pupils.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqotda besh yuz nafar maktab o'quvchisidan iborat tanlanma ishlatilgan.

words.definitionEn: a study in which many people are asked the same questions; collocation: conduct a survey
words.exampleEn: A recent survey found that students sleep too little.
words.exampleUz: So'nggi so'rov talabalar juda kam uxlashini aniqladi.

words.definitionEn: a set of written questions used to collect information; collocation: fill in a questionnaire
words.exampleEn: Two hundred teachers filled in the questionnaire.
words.exampleUz: Ikki yuz o'qituvchi anketani to'ldirdi.

words.definitionEn: a person who takes part in a study or activity; collocation: participants in the study (participate (v) — participant (n))
words.exampleEn: All participants in the experiment were volunteers.
words.exampleUz: Tajribadagi barcha ishtirokchilar ko'ngillilar edi.

words.definitionEn: the information that a study discovers; collocation: the findings suggest/show that
words.exampleEn: The findings suggest that short lessons work better.
words.exampleUz: Natijalar qisqa darslar samaraliroq ekanini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: facts and numbers collected for study; collocation: collect/analyse data
words.exampleEn: The team collected data from twelve schools.
words.exampleUz: Jamoa o'n ikki maktabdan ma'lumot to'pladi.

words.definitionEn: numbers that show facts about a situation; collocation: official statistics (statistics (n) — statistical (adj))
words.exampleEn: Official statistics show a rise in university applications.
words.exampleUz: Rasmiy statistika universitetga arizalar ortganini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: a connection between two things that change together; collocation: a strong correlation between A and B
words.exampleEn: There is a strong correlation between reading and writing scores.
words.exampleUz: O'qish va yozish ballari o'rtasida kuchli bog'liqlik bor.

words.definitionEn: something in a study that can change and affect the result; collocation: control the variables
words.exampleEn: Researchers must control other variables carefully.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar boshqa o'zgaruvchilarni sinchkovlik bilan nazorat qilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to organise and carry out a study or test; collocation: conduct research/an interview
words.exampleEn: The institute conducted a study on exam stress.
words.exampleUz: Institut imtihon stressi bo'yicha tadqiqot o'tkazdi.

words.definitionEn: to try to find out the facts about something; collocation: investigate the causes of (investigate (v) — investigation (n))
words.exampleEn: The study investigates why many learners stop at B1.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqot ko'p o'rganuvchilar nega B1 darajada to'xtab qolishini o'rganadi.

words.definitionEn: to watch carefully in order to learn something; collocation: observe behaviour (observe (v) — observation (n))
words.exampleEn: The researchers observed thirty lessons in five schools.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar besh maktabda o'ttizta darsni kuzatishdi.

words.definitionEn: to find the size, level or amount of something; collocation: measure progress (measure (v) — measurement (n))
words.exampleEn: It is difficult to measure progress in speaking.
words.exampleUz: Gapirishdagi rivojni o'lchash qiyin.

words.definitionEn: to say approximately how much or how many; collocation: it is estimated that
words.exampleEn: Experts estimate that half of the candidates need more practice.
words.exampleUz: Mutaxassislar nomzodlarning yarmiga ko'proq mashq kerakligini taxmin qilishadi.

words.definitionEn: to explain the meaning of results or words; collocation: interpret the data (interpret (v) — interpretation (n))
words.exampleEn: The results can be interpreted in two different ways.
words.exampleUz: Natijalarni ikki xil talqin qilish mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to decide something after considering the facts; collocation: the study concludes that (conclude (v) — conclusion (n))
words.exampleEn: The authors conclude that homework should be shorter.
words.exampleUz: Mualliflar uy vazifasi qisqaroq bo'lishi kerak, deb xulosa qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to print a text or put it online for people to read; collocation: publish a paper/study (publish (v) — publication (n))
words.exampleEn: The results were published in an international journal.
words.exampleUz: Natijalar xalqaro jurnalda nashr etildi.

words.definitionEn: a magazine containing serious articles on one subject; collocation: an academic journal
words.exampleEn: She reads two academic journals every month.
words.exampleUz: U har oy ikkita ilmiy jurnal o'qiydi.

words.definitionEn: a short summary at the beginning of a research paper
words.exampleEn: Read the abstract first to see if the article is useful.
words.exampleUz: Maqola foydali yoki yo'qligini bilish uchun avval annotatsiyani o'qing.

words.definitionEn: a careful examination or report on something; collocations: a literature review, peer review
words.exampleEn: The article begins with a review of earlier studies.
words.exampleUz: Maqola avvalgi tadqiqotlar sharhi bilan boshlanadi.

words.definitionEn: an unfair preference that affects a result; collocation: a clear bias towards (bias (n) — biased (adj))
words.exampleEn: The sample shows a clear bias towards city schools.
words.exampleUz: Tanlanmada shahar maktablariga aniq tarafkashlik ko'rinadi.

words.definitionEn: correct and exact in every detail; collocation: accurate figures/description (accurate (adj) — accuracy (n))
words.exampleEn: Examiners look for accurate grammar and spelling.
words.exampleUz: Imtihonchilar aniq grammatika va imloni qidiradi.

words.definitionEn: based on good reasons, or officially acceptable; collocation: a valid argument/point (valid (adj) — validity (n))
words.exampleEn: That is a valid point, but it needs more evidence.
words.exampleUz: Bu asosli fikr, lekin ko'proq dalil kerak.

words.definitionEn: closely connected with the topic being discussed; collocation: relevant to the question (relevant (adj) — relevance (n))
words.exampleEn: Include only examples that are relevant to the question.
words.exampleUz: Faqat savolga tegishli misollarni kiriting.

words.definitionEn: a clear and deep understanding of something; collocation: provide/gain an insight into
words.exampleEn: The report gives useful insights into student behaviour.
words.exampleUz: Hisobot talabalar xulqi haqida foydali tushunchalar beradi.

words.definitionEn: to find and take on new people to work in a company; collocation: recruit staff (recruit (v) — recruitment (n))
words.exampleEn: The bank is recruiting staff for its new branch.
words.exampleUz: Bank yangi filiali uchun xodimlar ishga olmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a person who formally asks for a job or a place; collocation: a suitable applicant
words.exampleEn: Only five applicants were invited to the second stage.
words.exampleUz: Ikkinchi bosqichga faqat besh talabgor taklif qilindi.

words.definitionEn: a person taking an exam or competing for a job; collocation: a strong candidate
words.exampleEn: The strongest candidate was offered the job immediately.
words.exampleUz: Eng kuchli nomzodga ish darhol taklif qilindi.

words.definitionEn: a job that is available; collocation: fill/advertise a vacancy (vacant (adj) — vacancy (n))
words.exampleEn: The company advertised three vacancies for engineers.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniya muhandislar uchun uchta bo'sh ish o'rni e'lon qildi.

words.definitionEn: a period of work done to gain experience, often unpaid; collocation: do a summer internship
words.exampleEn: She did a three-month internship at a law firm.
words.exampleUz: U yuridik firmada uch oylik amaliyot o'tdi.

words.definitionEn: all the people who work in a company or country; collocation: a skilled workforce
words.exampleEn: A skilled workforce attracts foreign investment.
words.exampleUz: Malakali ishchi kuchi xorijiy sarmoyani jalb qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a person you work with; collocation: a close colleague
words.exampleEn: I discussed the report with my colleagues.
words.exampleUz: Hisobotni hamkasblarim bilan muhokama qildim.

words.definitionEn: to give part of your work or power to someone else; collocation: delegate tasks/responsibility
words.exampleEn: Good managers delegate tasks to their team.
words.exampleUz: Yaxshi menejerlar vazifalarni jamoasiga topshiradi.

words.definitionEn: the amount of work a person has to do; collocation: a heavy workload
words.exampleEn: Teachers often complain about their heavy workload.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilar ko'pincha og'ir ish hajmidan shikoyat qilishadi.

words.definitionEn: extra hours worked beyond normal working time; collocation: work overtime, be paid overtime
words.exampleEn: He works overtime twice a week.
words.exampleUz: U haftasiga ikki marta qo'shimcha vaqt ishlaydi.

words.definitionEn: a fixed period of work in a factory or hospital; collocation: work the night shift
words.exampleEn: Nurses often work the night shift.
words.exampleUz: Hamshiralar ko'pincha tungi smenada ishlaydi.

words.definitionEn: money paid for work, usually weekly or by the hour; collocation: the minimum wage
words.exampleEn: The government raised the minimum wage last year.
words.exampleUz: Hukumat o'tgan yili eng kam ish haqini oshirdi.

words.definitionEn: extra money given for good work; collocation: an annual bonus
words.exampleEn: Staff received a bonus for reaching the sales target.
words.exampleUz: Xodimlar savdo rejasini bajargani uchun mukofot pul olishdi.

words.definitionEn: money paid regularly to people who have stopped working; collocation: a state pension
words.exampleEn: He receives a state pension every month.
words.exampleUz: U har oy davlat nafaqasini oladi.

words.definitionEn: to officially leave your job; collocation: resign from a post (resign (v) — resignation (n))
words.exampleEn: The manager resigned after only six months.
words.exampleUz: Menejer atigi olti oydan keyin ishdan bo'shadi.

words.definitionEn: to make someone leave a job, or to refuse to accept an idea; collocation: dismiss an employee/an idea
words.exampleEn: Two workers were dismissed for breaking safety rules.
words.exampleUz: Ikki ishchi xavfsizlik qoidalarini buzgani uchun ishdan bo'shatildi.

words.definitionEn: to stop working because you have reached a certain age; collocation: retire at sixty (retire (v) — retirement (n))
words.exampleEn: My father retired at the age of sixty.
words.exampleUz: Otam oltmish yoshida nafaqaga chiqdi.

words.definitionEn: working for different companies rather than one employer; collocation: a freelance designer
words.exampleEn: She works as a freelance translator.
words.exampleUz: U erkin tarjimon sifatida ishlaydi.

words.definitionEn: far away, or done from home instead of an office; collocations: remote work, a remote area (remote (adj) — remotely (adv))
words.exampleEn: Remote work has become normal in the IT sector.
words.exampleUz: Masofaviy ish IT sohasida odatiy holga aylandi.

words.definitionEn: to travel regularly between home and work; collocation: commute to work (commute (v) — commuter (n))
words.exampleEn: Thousands of people commute to Tashkent every day.
words.exampleUz: Har kuni minglab odam Toshkentga qatnaydi.

words.definitionEn: how much work is produced in a period of time; collocation: increase productivity (produce (v) — productivity (n), productive (adj))
words.exampleEn: New machines increased productivity by twenty per cent.
words.exampleUz: Yangi mashinalar unumdorlikni yigirma foizga oshirdi.

words.definitionEn: working well without wasting time or money; collocation: improve efficiency (efficient (adj) — efficiency (n))
words.exampleEn: Automation improved the efficiency of the factory.
words.exampleUz: Avtomatlashtirish zavod samaradorligini oshirdi.

words.definitionEn: something that encourages people to act; collocation: a financial incentive
words.exampleEn: Tax cuts are a strong incentive for small businesses.
words.exampleUz: Soliq imtiyozlari kichik biznes uchun kuchli rag'bat.

words.definitionEn: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement; collocation: negotiate a contract/salary (negotiate (v) — negotiation (n))
words.exampleEn: The union negotiated better conditions for workers.
words.exampleUz: Kasaba uyushmasi ishchilar uchun yaxshiroq shart-sharoit bo'yicha muzokara olib bordi.

words.definitionEn: a legal written agreement between two sides; collocation: sign/renew a contract
words.exampleEn: He signed a two-year contract with the company.
words.exampleUz: U kompaniya bilan ikki yillik shartnoma imzoladi.

words.definitionEn: a person or company that pays for a professional service; collocation: attract new clients
words.exampleEn: Our main client is a construction company.
words.exampleUz: Asosiy mijozimiz — qurilish kompaniyasi.

words.definitionEn: a company that makes goods in large numbers; collocation: a car manufacturer (manufacture (v) — manufacturer (n))
words.exampleEn: The car manufacturer opened a plant in Andijan.
words.exampleUz: Avtomobil ishlab chiqaruvchi Andijonda zavod ochdi.

words.definitionEn: the money a company or government receives; collocations: annual revenue, tax revenue
words.exampleEn: The company's annual revenue doubled in three years.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniyaning yillik daromadi uch yilda ikki baravar oshdi.

words.definitionEn: the total amount of money spent; collocation: public expenditure
words.exampleEn: Public expenditure on education has risen sharply.
words.exampleUz: Ta'limga davlat xarajatlari keskin oshdi.

words.definitionEn: the total amount of business done, or the rate at which staff leave; collocations: annual turnover, staff turnover
words.exampleEn: High staff turnover costs companies a lot of money.
words.exampleUz: Kadrlarning tez almashuvi kompaniyalarga katta pulga tushadi.

words.definitionEn: something valuable that a person or company owns; collocation: a valuable asset
words.exampleEn: Experienced staff are a company's greatest asset.
words.exampleUz: Tajribali xodimlar — kompaniyaning eng katta boyligi.

words.definitionEn: money that you owe to someone; collocations: pay off a debt, get into debt
words.exampleEn: Many graduates leave university in debt.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p bitiruvchilar universitetni qarz bilan tugatadi.

words.definitionEn: money borrowed from a bank and paid back later; collocations: take out a loan, repay a loan
words.exampleEn: They took out a loan to open a small bakery.
words.exampleUz: Ular kichik novvoyxona ochish uchun kredit oldi.

words.definitionEn: the percentage charged for borrowing money; collocation: raise/cut interest rates
words.exampleEn: The bank cut interest rates to help small businesses.
words.exampleUz: Bank kichik biznesga yordam berish uchun foiz stavkalarini pasaytirdi.

words.definitionEn: the system of money used in a country; collocation: a strong/weak currency
words.exampleEn: A weak currency makes imported goods more expensive.
words.exampleUz: Kuchsiz valyuta import mollarini qimmatlashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: money given by a government to keep prices or costs low; collocation: government subsidies (subsidise (v) — subsidy (n))
words.exampleEn: Farmers receive subsidies for using new technology.
words.exampleUz: Fermerlar yangi texnologiya ishlatgani uchun subsidiya oladi.

words.definitionEn: money paid to the government from income or sales; collocations: pay taxes, raise taxes (tax (n/v) — taxation (n))
words.exampleEn: Small firms pay lower taxes in their first year.
words.exampleUz: Kichik firmalar birinchi yili kamroq soliq to'laydi.

words.definitionEn: a tax on goods coming into a country; collocation: impose tariffs on imports
words.exampleEn: The country imposed tariffs on imported sugar.
words.exampleUz: Mamlakat import shakarga boj joriy qildi.

words.definitionEn: to sell and send goods to another country; collocation: export goods to (export (v/n) — exporter (n))
words.exampleEn: Uzbekistan exports fruit to Russia and China.
words.exampleUz: O'zbekiston Rossiya va Xitoyga meva eksport qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to buy and bring in goods from another country; collocation: import raw materials
words.exampleEn: The factory imports most of its raw materials.
words.exampleUz: Zavod xom ashyoning ko'p qismini import qiladi.

words.definitionEn: the activity of buying and selling goods; collocations: international trade, free trade
words.exampleEn: Trade between the two countries has grown rapidly.
words.exampleUz: Ikki davlat o'rtasidagi savdo tez o'sdi.

words.definitionEn: the amount of something that is available to buy; key collocation: supply and demand
words.exampleEn: Prices rise when supply cannot meet demand.
words.exampleUz: Taklif talabni qoplay olmasa, narxlar oshadi.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which there is not enough of something; collocation: a shortage of skilled workers
words.exampleEn: There is a serious shortage of qualified IT teachers.
words.exampleUz: Malakali IT o'qituvchilari jiddiy tanqisligi bor.

words.definitionEn: an amount that is more than what is needed; collocation: a trade surplus
words.exampleEn: The country produced a surplus of cotton this year.
words.exampleUz: Mamlakat bu yil ortiqcha paxta yetishtirdi.

words.definitionEn: a large amount of money and property; collocation: create/distribute wealth (wealth (n) — wealthy (adj))
words.exampleEn: The reforms aim to distribute wealth more fairly.
words.exampleUz: Islohotlar boylikni adolatliroq taqsimlashga qaratilgan.

words.definitionEn: money that a person or family regularly receives; collocations: a low income, household income
words.exampleEn: Families on a low income receive extra support.
words.exampleUz: Kam daromadli oilalar qo'shimcha yordam oladi.

words.definitionEn: money spent on a particular thing; collocations: travel expenses, at great expense (expense (n) — expensive (adj))
words.exampleEn: The company covers all travel expenses.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniya barcha yo'l xarajatlarini qoplaydi.

words.definitionEn: to have enough money or time for something; collocation: cannot afford to (afford (v) — affordable (adj))
words.exampleEn: Many families cannot afford private lessons.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p oilalarning xususiy darslarga imkoni yo'q.

words.definitionEn: a person who starts businesses and takes financial risks; collocation: a young entrepreneur
words.exampleEn: Young entrepreneurs are changing the local economy.

words.definitionEn: to show something bad publicly, or to leave somebody unprotected; collocations: expose corruption, be exposed to (expose (v) — exposure (n))
words.exampleEn: Journalists exposed corruption in the housing programme.
words.exampleUz: Jurnalistlar uy-joy dasturidagi korrupsiyani fosh qildi.

words.definitionEn: to tell people about something officially; collocation: announce a decision (announce (v) — announcement (n))
words.exampleEn: The ministry announced new exam dates.
words.exampleUz: Vazirlik yangi imtihon sanalarini e'lon qildi.

words.definitionEn: to say what is wrong with someone or something; collocation: criticise a decision (criticise (v) — criticism (n), critical (adj))
words.exampleEn: Experts criticised the decision to shorten the school year.
words.exampleUz: Mutaxassislar o'quv yilini qisqartirish qarorini tanqid qilishdi.

words.definitionEn: a written or spoken opinion about something; collocations: post a comment, no comment
words.exampleEn: The post received hundreds of angry comments.
words.exampleUz: Post yuzlab g'azabli izohlar oldi.

words.definitionEn: a person who watches television or a video; collocation: attract viewers
words.exampleEn: The show attracts millions of viewers each week.
words.exampleUz: Ko'rsatuv har hafta millionlab tomoshabin jalb qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a person who pays to receive a service regularly; collocation: gain subscribers (subscribe (v) — subscriber (n), subscription (n))
words.exampleEn: The channel gained fifty thousand subscribers in a month.
words.exampleUz: Kanal bir oyda ellik ming obunachi to'pladi.

words.definitionEn: the information contained in a website, video or book; collocations: online content, a content creator
words.exampleEn: Young people spend hours watching short online content.
words.exampleUz: Yoshlar qisqa onlayn kontentni soatlab tomosha qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a website or app where people share, learn or sell; collocation: a social media platform
words.exampleEn: Every social media platform has its own rules.
words.exampleUz: Har bir ijtimoiy tarmoq platformasining o'z qoidalari bor.

words.definitionEn: spreading very quickly on the internet; key collocation: go viral
words.exampleEn: The video went viral within two days.
words.exampleUz: Video ikki kun ichida keng tarqaldi.

words.definitionEn: a general change or development over time; collocation: a growing trend towards (trend (n) — trendy (adj))
words.exampleEn: There is a growing trend towards online shopping.
words.exampleUz: Onlayn xaridga bo'lgan tendensiya kuchaymoqda.

words.definitionEn: a famous person, especially in entertainment; collocation: celebrity culture
words.exampleEn: Teenagers often copy the habits of celebrities.
words.exampleUz: O'smirlar ko'pincha mashhur shaxslarning odatlarini nusxalaydi.

words.definitionEn: a fixed and often unfair idea about a group of people; collocation: reinforce/challenge a stereotype
words.exampleEn: The film challenges old stereotypes about village life.
words.exampleUz: Film qishloq hayoti haqidagi eski stereotiplarga qarshi chiqadi.

words.definitionEn: knowledge of a situation or problem; collocation: raise awareness of (aware (adj) — awareness (n))
words.exampleEn: The campaign raised awareness of water saving.
words.exampleUz: Kampaniya suv tejash haqidagi xabardorlikni oshirdi.

words.definitionEn: a particular way of thinking about something; collocation: from a different perspective
words.exampleEn: The article looks at the problem from a rural perspective.
words.exampleUz: Maqola muammoga qishloq nuqtai nazaridan qaraydi.

words.definitionEn: a study of what people think, often before an election; collocation: an opinion poll
words.exampleEn: A recent poll showed strong support for the reform.
words.exampleUz: So'nggi so'rov islohotga kuchli qo'llab-quvvatlash borligini ko'rsatdi.

words.definitionEn: information passed from person to person that may not be true; collocation: spread a rumour
words.exampleEn: Rumours about the exam spread quickly on Telegram.
words.exampleUz: Imtihon haqidagi mish-mishlar Telegramda tez tarqaldi.

words.definitionEn: films, music and shows that people enjoy; collocation: the entertainment industry (entertain (v) — entertainment (n))
words.exampleEn: Streaming has changed the entertainment industry.
words.exampleUz: Striming ko'ngilochar sanoatni o'zgartirdi.

words.definitionEn: a film or programme giving facts about a real subject; collocation: a documentary about
words.exampleEn: We watched a documentary about the Aral Sea.
words.exampleUz: Orol dengizi haqidagi hujjatli filmni ko'rdik.

words.definitionEn: to reach more people or places; collocations: spread rapidly, spread information
words.exampleEn: False stories spread rapidly on social media.
words.exampleUz: Yolg'on xabarlar ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda tez tarqaladi.

words.definitionEn: a strong effect on someone or something; key collocation: have an impact on
words.exampleEn: Social media has a huge impact on teenagers.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar o'smirlarga katta ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: accepted or used by most people; collocation: mainstream media
words.exampleEn: Mainstream media rarely reports these stories.
words.exampleUz: Ommaviy OAV bu voqealarni kamdan-kam yoritadi.

words.definitionEn: a reason given to support an opinion; collocation: put forward a strong argument (argue (v) — argument (n))
words.exampleEn: The writer puts forward a strong argument for free tests.
words.exampleUz: Muallif bepul testlar foydasiga kuchli dalil keltiradi.

words.definitionEn: a formal discussion of opposing views; collocation: a heated debate about
words.exampleEn: There is a heated debate about mobile phones in schools.
words.exampleUz: Maktabda mobil telefonlar haqida qizg'in munozara bor.

words.definitionEn: to say that something is true without giving proof; collocation: claim that (claim (v/n) — claimant (n))
words.exampleEn: The company claims that its product saves energy.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniya mahsuloti energiya tejashini da'vo qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a particular way of looking at a subject; collocation: from my viewpoint
words.exampleEn: The essay presents both viewpoints fairly.
words.exampleUz: Insho ikkala qarashni ham xolis taqdim etadi.

words.definitionEn: the way you think and feel about something; collocation: a positive attitude towards
words.exampleEn: Public attitudes towards recycling are changing.
words.exampleUz: Chiqindini qayta ishlashga jamoatchilik munosabati o'zgarmoqda.

words.definitionEn: an opinion that everyone in a group agrees with; collocation: reach a consensus
words.exampleEn: The group finally reached a consensus.
words.exampleUz: Guruh nihoyat umumiy kelishuvga erishdi.

words.definitionEn: a reason for disagreeing with something; collocation: raise an objection to
words.exampleEn: Several parents raised objections to the new timetable.
words.exampleUz: Bir necha ota-ona yangi jadvalga e'tiroz bildirdi.

words.definitionEn: to disagree with a plan and try to stop it; collocation: strongly oppose (oppose (v) — opposition (n), opposed (adj))
words.exampleEn: Many teachers strongly oppose longer school days.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p o'qituvchilar uzunroq o'quv kuniga qattiq qarshi chiqadi.

words.definitionEn: to agree with an idea, or to provide proof for it; key collocation: support a claim with evidence
words.exampleEn: These figures support the writer's main claim.
words.exampleUz: Bu raqamlar muallifning asosiy fikrini tasdiqlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to give good reasons for something; collocation: justify a decision (justify (v) — justification (n))
words.exampleEn: You must justify your opinion with clear examples.
words.exampleUz: Fikringizni aniq misollar bilan asoslashingiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: the reasons for a belief or action; key collocation: on the grounds that
words.exampleEn: The plan was rejected on economic grounds.
words.exampleUz: Reja iqtisodiy asoslarga ko'ra rad etildi.

words.definitionEn: to think something is true without checking it; collocation: assume that (assume (v) — assumption (n))
words.exampleEn: Do not assume that every source is honest.
words.exampleUz: Har bir manbani halol deb hisoblamang.

words.definitionEn: to suggest something without saying it directly; collocation: the text implies that (imply (v) — implication (n))
words.exampleEn: The writer implies that the policy has failed.
words.exampleUz: Muallif siyosat muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lganiga ishora qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to work out a meaning from the information given; collocation: infer from the passage (infer (v) — inference (n))
words.exampleEn: From the graph we can infer that prices will rise.
words.exampleUz: Grafikdan narxlar oshishini xulosa qilish mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to put forward an idea, or to show that something is probably true; key collocation: the evidence suggests that
words.exampleEn: The results suggest that short breaks improve memory.
words.exampleUz: Natijalar qisqa tanaffuslar xotirani yaxshilashini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to formally suggest a plan or idea; collocation: propose a solution (propose (v) — proposal (n))
words.exampleEn: The author proposes three practical solutions.
words.exampleUz: Muallif uchta amaliy yechim taklif etadi.

words.definitionEn: to say that something is a good idea; collocation: recommend doing something (recommend (v) — recommendation (n))
words.exampleEn: Experts recommend reading in English every day.
words.exampleUz: Mutaxassislar har kuni ingliz tilida o'qishni tavsiya qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to give special importance to a point; collocation: emphasise the need for (emphasise (v) — emphasis (n))
words.exampleEn: The report emphasises the need for better training.
words.exampleUz: Hisobot yaxshiroq tayyorgarlik zarurligiga urg'u beradi.

words.definitionEn: to draw attention to something important; collocation: highlight a problem
words.exampleEn: The study highlights the gap between city and village schools.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqot shahar va qishloq maktablari o'rtasidagi farqni alohida ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to accept that something is true, often before disagreeing; collocation: acknowledge that
words.exampleEn: The author acknowledges that the data are limited.
words.exampleUz: Muallif ma'lumotlar cheklanganini tan oladi.

words.definitionEn: to agree that something is true, often unwillingly; collocation: admit a mistake
words.exampleEn: He admitted that his first plan was too expensive.
words.exampleUz: U birinchi rejasi juda qimmat bo'lganini tan oldi.

words.definitionEn: to say that something is not true; collocation: deny the allegations (deny (v) — denial (n))
words.exampleEn: The company denied that the data had been sold.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniya ma'lumotlar sotilganini inkor etdi.

words.definitionEn: doubting that something is true or useful; collocation: sceptical about (sceptical (adj) — scepticism (n))
words.exampleEn: Many economists are sceptical about these forecasts.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p iqtisodchilar bu prognozlarga shubha bilan qaraydi.

words.definitionEn: to say the opposite, or to disagree with other facts; collocation: contradict the evidence (contradict (v) — contradiction (n))
words.exampleEn: These figures contradict the writer's conclusion.
words.exampleUz: Bu raqamlar muallifning xulosasiga zid keladi.

words.definitionEn: to say that something is not correct or fair; collocation: dispute a claim
words.exampleEn: Other researchers dispute these results.
words.exampleUz: Boshqa tadqiqotchilar bu natijalarga e'tiroz bildiradi.

words.definitionEn: to question whether something is right or true; collocation: challenge an assumption
words.exampleEn: The article challenges the idea that money brings happiness.
words.exampleUz: Maqola pul baxt keltiradi degan fikrni shubha ostiga oladi.

words.definitionEn: to make something weaker, especially an argument or confidence; collocation: undermine an argument
words.exampleEn: Weak examples undermine an otherwise good essay.
words.exampleUz: Zaif misollar boshqa jihatdan yaxshi bo'lgan inshoga putur yetkazadi.

words.definitionEn: to make an idea or feeling stronger; collocation: reinforce a point/stereotype
words.exampleEn: The second paragraph reinforces the main point.
words.exampleUz: Ikkinchi xatboshi asosiy fikrni mustahkamlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to make something easier to understand; collocation: clarify a point (clarify (v) — clarification (n))
words.exampleEn: Could you clarify what you mean by success?
words.exampleUz: Muvaffaqiyat deganda nimani nazarda tutayotganingizni aniqlashtirasizmi?

words.definitionEn: to show the meaning of something by giving an example; collocation: illustrate a point (illustrate (v) — illustration (n))
words.exampleEn: This example illustrates the main problem clearly.
words.exampleUz: Bu misol asosiy muammoni aniq ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to show clearly that something is true; collocation: demonstrate that (demonstrate (v) — demonstration (n))
words.exampleEn: The study demonstrates that regular practice works.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqot muntazam mashq samara berishini isbotlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to show that something is probably true; key collocation: the data indicate that (indicate (v) — indication (n))
words.exampleEn: The graph indicates a steady fall in exports.
words.exampleUz: Grafik eksportning barqaror pasayishini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to show or express something; collocations: reflect a change, reflect on an idea (reflect (v) — reflection (n))
words.exampleEn: These results reflect a wider change in society.
words.exampleUz: Bu natijalar jamiyatdagi kengroq o'zgarishni aks ettiradi.

words.definitionEn: to think of somebody or something in a particular way; key pattern: regard A as B
words.exampleEn: Many people regard English as the key to a good job.
words.exampleUz: Ko'pchilik ingliz tilini yaxshi ishning kaliti deb hisoblaydi.

words.definitionEn: to consider something when making a decision; variant: take account of
words.exampleEn: We must take into account the cost of the project.
words.exampleUz: Loyihaning narxini hisobga olishimiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: considering everything; used to give a balanced summary in writing
words.exampleEn: On the whole, the advantages outweigh the problems.
words.exampleUz: Umuman olganda, afzalliklar muammolardan ustun.

words.definitionEn: partly but not completely; a useful way to half-agree with an opinion
words.exampleEn: I agree with this view to some extent.
words.exampleUz: Bu fikrga ma'lum darajada qo'shilaman.

words.definitionEn: used to say something can be argued although others may disagree; softens a strong claim
words.exampleEn: Reading is arguably the most useful exam skill.
words.exampleUz: O'qish, aytish mumkinki, imtihondagi eng foydali ko'nikma.

words.definitionEn: certainly, without any doubt; used to strengthen a claim
words.exampleEn: Technology has undoubtedly changed education.
words.exampleUz: Texnologiya shubhasiz ta'limni o'zgartirdi.

words.definitionEn: used to say that something is probably true, based on what you know
words.exampleEn: Presumably, the results will be published next month.
words.exampleUz: Ehtimol, natijalar keyingi oy e'lon qilinadi.

words.definitionEn: according to what seems true or what people say, though it may not be certain
words.exampleEn: Apparently, the exam format will change next year.
words.exampleUz: Ko'rinishidan, imtihon formati kelasi yil o'zgaradi.

words.definitionEn: when compared with other things; collocations: relatively small, relatively cheap
words.exampleEn: The course is relatively cheap compared with private lessons.
words.exampleUz: Kurs xususiy darslarga nisbatan arzon.

words.definitionEn: by a large amount; collocations: considerably higher, considerably lower
words.exampleEn: Scores were considerably higher after the practice tests.
words.exampleUz: Sinov testlaridan keyin ballar sezilarli darajada yuqori bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: a little; used to describe small differences in a chart or trend
words.exampleEn: The number of candidates rose slightly in 2024.
words.exampleUz: Nomzodlar soni 2024-yilda biroz oshdi.

words.definitionEn: especially; used to introduce an important example
words.exampleEn: Some regions, notably Karakalpakstan, need more teachers.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi hududlarda, xususan Qoraqalpog'istonda, ko'proq o'qituvchi kerak.

words.definitionEn: in the same way; used to add a second similar point
words.exampleEn: Reading helps writing; likewise, listening improves speaking.
words.exampleUz: O'qish yozishga yordam beradi; xuddi shunday, tinglash gapirishni yaxshilaydi.

words.definitionEn: in a similar way; used to compare two ideas or examples
words.exampleEn: City schools got extra funding. Similarly, rural schools received new books.
words.exampleUz: Shahar maktablari qo'shimcha mablag' oldi. Shunga o'xshab, qishloq maktablari yangi kitoblar oldi.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce an opposite situation or result
words.exampleEn: Conversely, too much screen time harms concentration.
words.exampleUz: Aksincha, ekran oldida ortiqcha vaqt diqqatni yomonlashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: used to introduce a second possible choice (alternative (n/adj) — alternatively (adv))
words.exampleEn: Alternatively, students could take the test online.
words.exampleUz: Yoki bo'lmasa, talabalar testni onlayn topshirishlari mumkin.

words.definitionEn: for this reason (formal); similar to therefore
words.exampleEn: The city is growing; hence, more schools are needed.
words.exampleUz: Shahar o'smoqda; shu sababli ko'proq maktab kerak.

words.definitionEn: used to say something happens although there is a difficulty; note the pattern: despite + noun or -ing, never despite of
words.exampleEn: Despite the heavy rain, the festival continued.
words.exampleUz: Kuchli yomg'irga qaramay, festival davom etdi.

words.definitionEn: without being affected by a particular thing
words.exampleEn: The course is free regardless of your age.
words.exampleUz: Kurs yoshingizdan qat'i nazar bepul.

words.definitionEn: used to show a clear difference between two things; variant: in contrast to
words.exampleEn: In contrast, rural areas have far fewer libraries.
words.exampleUz: Farqli o'laroq, qishloq joylarda kutubxonalar ancha kam.

words.definitionEn: used to show a difference in amount or quality; variant: compared to
words.exampleEn: Compared with last year, the results have improved.
words.exampleUz: O'tgan yil bilan solishtirganda, natijalar yaxshilandi.

words.definitionEn: to be more important or valuable than something else; key collocation: the benefits outweigh the drawbacks
words.exampleEn: In my view, the benefits outweigh the risks.
words.exampleUz: Menimcha, foydalar xavflardan ustun.

words.definitionEn: a disadvantage of a plan or idea; collocation: the main drawback is
words.exampleEn: The main drawback of online study is weak motivation.
words.exampleUz: Onlayn o'qishning asosiy kamchiligi — motivatsiyaning zaifligi.

words.definitionEn: a good feature that deserves praise; collocation: the merits of an idea
words.exampleEn: Both proposals have their merits.
words.exampleUz: Ikkala taklifning ham o'z afzalliklari bor.

words.definitionEn: to make a general statement from only a few examples; collocation: it is dangerous to generalise (generalise (v) — generalisation (n))
words.exampleEn: It is dangerous to generalise from a single study.
words.exampleUz: Bitta tadqiqotdan umumiy xulosa chiqarish xavfli.

words.definitionEn: to usually do something; a safe way to avoid absolute claims (tend (v) — tendency (n))
words.exampleEn: Younger learners tend to speak more confidently.
words.exampleUz: Yosh o'rganuvchilar odatda ishonchliroq gapiradi.

words.definitionEn: based on facts, not on personal feelings; opposite: subjective (objective (adj) — objectivity (n))
words.exampleEn: A good report must be objective and balanced.
words.exampleUz: Yaxshi hisobot xolis va muvozanatli bo'lishi kerak.
